title: Agent Forest: Scaling LLM Agent Performance with More Agents and Simple Sampling-and-Voting

defines.name: Agent Forest
defines.definition: A simple sampling-and-voting framework that improves LLM performance by instantiating more agents, collecting multiple outputs, and selecting the final result by majority vote.

problem: Existing LLM agent collaboration methods are often complex and lack a dedicated study of whether simply increasing the number of agents can systematically improve performance.
